name: The Betrayed Dragon
source:
Living forever does not do the laundry, that's kind of your job. At least the person your working for is hot.

Ember is a young male dragon, recently turned god, that is trying to enjoy life after having helped save the kingdom. Of course when his big sister, and crush ends up making him free use to all of her friends by mistake, well... things get real horny, real quick.

[From [url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-betrayed-dragon]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
能永生也不等於衣服會自己洗，這份差事多半還是得你來。好在你侍奉的那位倒是很性感。

恩伯是一條年輕的雄龍，剛剛成神。幫助拯救王國後，他正試著享受生活。偏偏姊姊——也是他的暗戀對象——一不小心，讓自己的所有朋友都可以隨意佔有他。於是嘛……氣氛一下子就變得色慾高漲。

[摘自[url=https://thecrimsonnight.itch.io/the-betrayed-dragon]itch.io[/url]]
